executive_summary: OFAC added 9 new entities to the SDN list under the SDGT program, primarily targeting individuals and entities in Syria, Turkey, and Nigeria. The additions include bitcoin exchange agents, real estate companies, and bureau de change limited companies. No entities were removed or updated.

notable_entities.significance: Individual added to the SDN list with ties to France and Syria

risk_implications.description: The additions of entities in Syria and Turkey may indicate increased sanctions risk for companies operating in these regions
The additions of entities in Nigeria may indicate increased sanctions risk for companies operating in the financial sector

program_highlights.note: All 9 additions were made under the SDGT program, targeting individuals and entities involved in terrorist activities

compliance_recommendations: Conduct thorough due diligence on all business partners and clients
Ensure compliance with all applicable sanctions regulations
